title: anagallis arvensis subsp. phoenicea
intro: Anagallis arvensis subsp. phoenicea, commonly known as Red Pimpernel, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Primulaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Red Pimpernel are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant and free radical scavenging activities. However, more research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant species.
